answer: Divergent challenge seeding: assign each identity a hidden kernel of unique random challenges whose answers must evolve with accumulated state. A clone that forks to answer two different challenges identically diverges at the next round, exposing the split like a lotus opening. The system flags any onyx-marked identity whose response history fails replay consistency, freezing its balance. Cost: an attacker must run fully independent state per clone, paying full compute and storage per identity.
